name: Dreadmist Camp
summary: Dreadmist Camp is a small Horde waystation situated along the Gold Road at the western base of Dreadmist Peak. Overlooked by the craggy peak above, it provides shelter, supplies, and security for caravans traveling north from the Crossroads toward Ashenvale.

sections.title: A Waystation on the Gold Road
sections.body: Positioned just north of the Crossroads, Dreadmist Camp sits directly alongside the heavily traveled Gold Road. Run by Nagala Whipshank, the outpost serves as an essential stopping point for Horde caravans hauling goods across the arid plains of the Barrens. Teamsters, kodos, and guards rest here beneath the shadow of Dreadmist Peak, gathering provisions and bracing for the long treks north toward the Ashenvale border or south through quilboar territory.

sections.title: Under the Shadow of the Peak
sections.body: While convenient for road transit, the camp's location beneath Dreadmist Peak leaves it under an uneasy shadow. The towering crag above has become infested with sinister cultists and dark practitioners. Though the Horde maintains guards to secure the wagons and travelers below, the ominous energies seeping from the heights remain a constant concern for everyone stationed at the road.

faq.q: What is Dreadmist Camp used for?
faq.answer: Dreadmist Camp functions as a secure Horde rest stop and supply depot along the Gold Road. It provides shelter, kodo staging, and provisions for supply caravans traveling north from the Crossroads.
The encampment is overseen by Nagala Whipshank, who manages the staging of caravans and coordinates the handlers and guards stationed along the trade route.

faq.q: Why is the camp named Dreadmist?
faq.answer: The camp takes its name from Dreadmist Peak, the jagged, craggy mountain at whose base the encampment sits.

faq.q: Is Dreadmist Camp safe from the threats on Dreadmist Peak?
faq.answer: Horde sentries keep the road secure for passing caravans, but the sinister cultists and dark rituals occupying the heights of Dreadmist Peak make the post an uneasy posting for travelers and workers alike.

angles.text: For Horde logistics, Dreadmist Camp is a crucial lifeline, ensuring food, timber, and arms flow safely between the Crossroads and the northern frontier.
